name: adsb
description: ADS-B and Mode S aircraft on 1090 MHz: identification, position, velocity, altitude and squawk

fields.name: icao
fields.description: the aircraft's 24-bit address, six hex digits

fields.name: callsign
fields.description: the flight's callsign or the aircraft's registration, as it sends it

fields.name: category
fields.description: emitter category: set and code, A1 light to A5 heavy, A7 rotorcraft

fields.name: altitude_ft
fields.description: pressure altitude, or GNSS height for type codes 20 to 22

fields.name: airspeed_kn
fields.description: indicated or true airspeed, sent when ground speed is not

fields.name: squawk
fields.description: the transponder's identity code, four octal digits

fields.name: df
fields.description: Mode S downlink format: 17 ADS-B, 18 non-transponder ADS-B, 11 all-call reply, 4, 5, 20, 21 surveillance replies

fields.name: tc
fields.description: ADS-B type code: 1-4 identification, 5-8 surface position, 9-18 and 20-22 airborne position, 19 velocity
